goal: Evidence board for collaborative inquiry groups in frontend/src/app/learn/ and backend routers.
summary: Implemented and verified a collaborative comparative source evidence board for peer inquiry groups with 4-column categorization (supporting, refuting, synthesis, unresolved), source-to-source and source-to-claim comparative links, teacher inline feedback annotations, revision cycles with audit history, and strict negative abuse isolation rejecting unauthorized cross-group alterations or student inspection.
invariants_enforced: COLLABORATIVE_EVIDENCE_BOARD: Peer groups organize evidence citations into 4 distinct pedagogical columns (supporting, refuting, synthesis, unresolved) with contributor attribution and dynamic positioning.

COMPARATIVE_LINKS: Peer groups establish comparative evidence relations between sources and claims with explicit relation types (supports, refutes, corroborates, contrasts, qualifies) and reasoned rationales.

TEACHER_INLINE_FEEDBACK: Only classroom teachers and authorized staff can provide inline pedagogical commentary on board cards and sections (strictly rejected with HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE for students).

REVISION_CYCLES: Teacher revision requests unlock the board for subsequent student revisions, recording revision actions and notes in revision_history and incrementing revision_cycle upon resubmission.

STRICT_NEGATIVE_ABUSE_ISOLATION: Students outside the group CANNOT view private boards, inject evidence cards, update cards, delete cards, create comparative links, or access revision histories (strictly rejected with HTTP 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE).
